results.question: Emotional face processing in people with anxiety disorders
results.explanation: Find datasets involving emotional face processing in participants with anxiety disorders.

FROM (
SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type, d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status, d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text, COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count FROM bids_datasets AS d LEFT JOIN bids_objects AS o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND NOT o.subject IS NULL WHERE ((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS p2 WHERE p2.dataset_id = d.id AND p2.diagnosis IN ('anxiety_disorder', 'post_traumatic_stress_disorder', 'obsessive_compulsive_disorder', 'panic_disorder')) OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'anxiety:AB | anxious:AB | (anxeity:AB & disorder:AB) | (anxietey:AB & disorder:AB) | ((post:AB <-> traumatic:AB) & stress:AB & disorder:AB) | ((obsessive:AB <-> compulsive:AB) & disorder:AB) | (panic:AB & disorder:AB)')) OR (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'anxiety | anxious | (anxeity & disorder) | (anxietey & disorder) | ((post <-> traumatic) & stress & disorder) | ((obsessive <-> compulsive) & disorder) | (panic & disorder)') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'anxiety | anxious | (anxeity & disorder) | (anxietey & disorder) | ((post <-> traumatic) & stress & disorder) | ((obsessive <-> compulsive) & disorder) | (panic & disorder)'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', '(anxiety | anxious | (anxeity & disorder) | (anxietey & disorder) | ((post <-> traumatic) & stress & disorder) | ((obsessive <-> compulsive) & disorder) | (panic & disorder))')))) AND ((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND o2.task = 'smiley_task') OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'emotional:AB & face:AB')) OR (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'emotional & face') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'emotional & face'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'emotional')))) GROUP BY d.id
) AS tier_base
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT GREATEST(us.u0, us.u1) AS uncertain_level, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('; ', CASE WHEN us.u0 = 1 AND us.p0 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u0 = 1 THEN '"anxiety" / "anxious" … appears only further down in the README' WHEN us.u0 = 2 THEN 'diagnosis not recorded' END, CASE WHEN us.u1 = 1 AND us.p1 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u1 = 1 THEN 'matches only part of the search; missing: face' END), '') AS uncertain_reasons,
         (CASE WHEN us.u0 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN us.u1 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_unsure, (us.u0 <= 1 OR us.u1 <= 1) AS has_evidence
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS p2 WHERE p2.dataset_id = d.id AND p2.diagnosis IN ('anxiety_disorder', 'post_traumatic_stress_disorder', 'obsessive_compulsive_disorder', 'panic_disorder')) OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'anxiety:AB | anxious:AB | (anxeity:AB & disorder:AB) | (anxietey:AB & disorder:AB) | ((post:AB <-> traumatic:AB) & stress:AB & disorder:AB) | ((obsessive:AB <-> compulsive:AB) & disorder:AB) | (panic:AB & disorder:AB)')) THEN 0 WHEN (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'anxiety | anxious | (anxeity & disorder) | (anxietey & disorder) | ((post <-> traumatic) & stress & disorder) | ((obsessive <-> compulsive) & disorder) | (panic & disorder)') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'anxiety | anxious | (anxeity & disorder) | (anxietey & disorder) | ((post <-> traumatic) & stress & disorder) | ((obsessive <-> compulsive) & disorder) | (panic & disorder)'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', '(anxiety | anxious | (anxeity & disorder) | (anxietey & disorder) | ((post <-> traumatic) & stress & disorder) | ((obsessive <-> compulsive) & disorder) | (panic & disorder))'))) THEN 1 WHEN NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS uk WHERE uk.dataset_id = d.id AND uk.diagnosis IS NOT NULL)) THEN 9 ELSE 9 END AS u0,
      CASE WHEN (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND o2.task = 'smiley_task') OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'emotional:AB & face:AB')) THEN 0 WHEN (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'emotional & face') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'emotional & face'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'emotional'))) THEN 1 ELSE 9 END AS u1,
      ((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'anxiety | anxious | (anxeity & disorder) | (anxietey & disorder) | ((post <-> traumatic) & stress & disorder) | ((obsessive <-> compulsive) & disorder) | (panic & disorder)') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'anxiety | anxious | (anxeity & disorder) | (anxietey & disorder) | ((post <-> traumatic) & stress & disorder) | ((obsessive <-> compulsive) & disorder) | (panic & disorder)'))) AS p0,
